intro: Refresh your space with Pebby Its L-shape gi.ves you more room to sprawl, while adjustable headrests, springy comfort, and soft support keep your family lounging longer together.

features.title: Mint green that uplifts your mood
features.text: The mint green finish adds a light, refreshing energy to your living room while staying easy to maintain, giving your home a contemporary, breezy vibe every day.

features.title: Adjustable headrests for custom comfort
features.text: Tilt each headrest until your neck and shoulders feel supported, so you can watch, read, or nap in the angle that feels best for you.

features.title: Pocket-spring seat for day-long ease
features.text: Pocket springs balance weight and keep the seating buoyant, so your sofa feels supportive even after hours of lounging or entertaining.

features.title: Ergonomic lumbar support
features.text: Thoughtful back contouring cradles your spine, helping you sit more naturally and easing tension after long hours of work or activity.

features.title: Wide armrests that add utility
features.text: Generous armrests let you rest easily, hold a tray, or create a side perch for comfort, making the sofa as practical as it is inviting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
